name: EQM
description: Stabilized a business-critical, offline-first internal app: 3 releases in 3 months, a 2,000+ test safety net, the full core migrated to TypeScript with AI in about a month, and the first AI agent shipped inside the product.

name: Tune-Up
description: A workout log that turns sessions into weekly summaries, built and launched solo on an agent-driven pipeline: planner, builder and reviewer agents, cost-aware model selection, and scheduled jobs that triage issues into release branches.

name: TryMate
description: Chess-meets-rugby strategy board game for the browser, with pass-and-play and real-time online rooms. Pure domain layer ported from a rules spec, swappable rooms gateway and 140+ tests, built through an issue-driven agent workflow.
tagline: Chess-meets-rugby strategy game for the browser, with pass-and-play and real-time online rooms.

name: Argentina Campeón del Mundo
description: Android app to browse and vote on the best photos of Argentina's 2022 World Cup win, ranked by pairwise community votes. Compose app on Clean Architecture + MVVM, with its own Ktor + MongoDB backend.
tagline: Android app + Ktor API to vote on the best photos of Argentina's 2022 World Cup win. The backend is no longer online.

name: HangApp
description: Took a beta MVP to a production-ready public release, with a complete UI/UX redesign and architecture overhaul.

name: Be Soul
description: Led the re-architecture of a digital-legacy and in-memorial app around Redux and SOLID principles for long-term scalability, and built its NestJS + MongoDB REST API with an OpenAI assistant.

name: PassApp
description: Android app maintained and extended for 10,000+ active users, delivering consistent feature updates over several years.

name: El Puma Contigo
description: Built from scratch with a continuous-integration workflow on Expo, integrating AI functionality to enhance user interaction.

name: Machine Stock
description: In-house stock-management Android app for a machinery trading company. I pitched the concept to the client and owned the full lifecycle, from UX/UI design and functional requirements to a Kotlin app on Clean Architecture (MVVM, use cases) with Firebase.
tagline: In-house stock-management Android app for a machinery trading company. I pitched the concept and owned it from UX/UI and requirements to delivery.

name: Stadium platform
description: Golf-training platform for service members: a native Android app (Java), the Stadium World app (React Native + Expo) and a Laravel REST API extended with AWS serverless services.
tagline: Golf-training platform for service members: native Android app (Java), Stadium World app (React Native + Expo) and a Laravel REST API.

name: Wao
description: Virtual prepaid-card app, first built as a native Android app and then migrated to React Native. Shelved before launch when the sponsor bank went under.
tagline: Virtual prepaid-card app: native Android (Kotlin), then migrated to React Native. Shelved when the sponsor bank went under.

name: Dalto Ambassadors
description: Flutter app to manage leads for a car-repair shop.
tagline: Flutter app to manage leads for a car-repair shop.

name: 100 Bubbles
description: Strategy game and my first Android app: self-taught from scratch and published on Google Play in 2020.
tagline: Strategy game and my first Android app: self-taught from scratch and published on Google Play in 2020.
